
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/batsing/p/20562520" title="发布于 2026-06-16 11:17">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">给博客加入黑客帝国背景字幕</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3>〇、效果如本页的背景所示，黑客帝国的字幕</h3>
<h3>一、本功能需要开通博客园的JS权限</h3>
<h3>二、在博客设置&nbsp;<strong>页脚HTML代码 </strong>贴入如下代码</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">黑客帝国背景，移动端不加入</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">canvas </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="matrixBG"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">canvas</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">src</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="https://files.cnblogs.com/files/batsing/matrix.js"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
$(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(){
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">let</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ua </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">( ua.indexOf(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mobile</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ){
      window.onload </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(){
        let matrix </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MatrixBG(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">matrixBG</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">2</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
      }
    }
});
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>其中引入的 matrix.js 是已封装好的核心代码，引入的关键是</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let matrix = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> MatrixBG("matrixBG", 2);</pre>
</div>
<p>其中，matrixBG 是&lt;canvas&gt;标签的id，后面的2是指用第2类背景字符，<strong>彝文</strong>。matrix.js内置了三种字符，1是注音字符，2是彝文，3是英文数字。可以自行测试不同文字的效果，我目前偏好彝文的效果，如果需要更多的字符可以自行下载修改代码添加，如藏文、蒙古文、梵文等。</p>
<p>特别安利一下彝族歌手约里（一朵云乐队）的歌，好听又有民族风格，另外彝族海来阿木的歌也不错。</p>
<h3>四、在 页面定制CSS代码 贴入如下代码</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">body </span>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    background</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> url("//photo.tuchong.com/1019978/f/21914120.jpg") fixed center center</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    background-repeat</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> no-repeat</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    background-size</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> cover</span>;
}<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
#matrixBG</span>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    position</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> fixed</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> top</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">0</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> left</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> 0</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    z-index</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> -1</span>;<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    animation</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> fade8 3s infinite</span>;
}<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
@keyframes fade8 </span>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    0% {
        opacity</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> 0.8</span>;
    }<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    50% </span>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
        opacity</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> 0.9</span>;
    }<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    100% </span>{<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
        opacity</span>:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> 0.8</span>;
    }<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>body添加了一张背景图，是广东省博物馆的夜景照片，暗红色作为背景，增加氛围感。</p>
<p>#matrixBG是黑客帝国背景主体，其中 z-index: -1; 为了让他在博客内容下层，不要遮挡博客内容，另外添加一个类呼吸灯的动画效果，与省博的暗红背景配合。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
